datasets.name: sales_to_date
datasets.query:
with period as (
  select cast(date_trunc('month', cast(timezone('Asia/Kolkata', now()) as date)) as date) as period_start,
         cast(timezone('Asia/Kolkata', now()) as date) as period_end
),
cutoff as (
  select p.period_start,
         least(p.period_end, coalesce((select max(actuals_as_of_date) from "marts"."sales"."target_vs_actual_daily"), p.period_end)) as effective_end,
         exists (select 1 from "marts"."sales"."target_vs_actual_daily" t
                 where t.hierarchy_level = 'material_group' and t.business_date between p.period_start and p.period_end) as targets_available
  from period p
),
stores as (
  select store_code, any_value(store_name) as store_name, any_value(short_code) as short_code
  from "gold"."masters"."store" group by 1
),
names as (
  select material_group_code, any_value(subcategory) as subcategory
  from "gold"."masters"."merchandise_hierarchy" where material_group_code is not null group by 1
),
targets as (
  select t.plant_code, t.hierarchy_code, t.business_date, t.target_daily_before_tax, t.actual_before_tax,
         t.target_quantity, t.actual_quantity
  from "marts"."sales"."target_vs_actual_daily" t cross join cutoff c
  where t.hierarchy_level = 'material_group' and t.business_date between c.period_start and c.effective_end
),
sales as (
  select s.store_code as plant_code, lpad(s.material_group, 9, '0') as hierarchy_code, s.business_date,
         sum(s.sales_before_tax_net) as actual_before_tax, sum(s.qty_net) as actual_quantity
  from "gold"."sales"."sales_item_daily" s cross join cutoff c
  where s.material_group is not null and s.business_date between c.period_start and c.effective_end
  group by 1, 2, 3
),
days as (
  select coalesce(t.plant_code, s.plant_code) as plant_code,
         coalesce(t.hierarchy_code, s.hierarchy_code) as hierarchy_code,
         t.target_daily_before_tax as target,
         case when t.plant_code is not null then t.actual_before_tax else s.actual_before_tax end as actual,
         t.target_quantity,
         case when t.plant_code is not null then t.actual_quantity else s.actual_quantity end as actual_quantity
  from targets t
  full join sales s on s.plant_code = t.plant_code and s.hierarchy_code = t.hierarchy_code and s.business_date = t.business_date
)
select d.plant_code as store_code, st.store_name, st.short_code,
       d.hierarchy_code as subcategory_code, n.subcategory,
       sum(d.target) as target, sum(d.actual) as actual,
       count(d.actual) as days_with_actual, count(*) as days,
       c.period_start, c.effective_end as data_through, c.targets_available,
       count(d.target) as target_days,
       sum(d.target_quantity) as target_quantity, sum(d.actual_quantity) as actual_quantity
from days d
cross join cutoff c
left join stores st on st.store_code = d.plant_code
left join names n on n.material_group_code = d.hierarchy_code
group by d.plant_code, st.store_name, st.short_code, d.hierarchy_code, n.subcategory, c.period_start, c.effective_end, c.targets_available

datasets.name: sales_month
datasets.query:
with period as (
  select cast(date_trunc('month', cast(timezone('Asia/Kolkata', now()) as date)) as date) as period_start,
         cast(timezone('Asia/Kolkata', now()) as date) as period_end
),
cutoff as (
  select p.period_start,
         least(p.period_end, coalesce((select max(actuals_as_of_date) from "marts"."sales"."target_vs_actual_daily"), p.period_end)) as effective_end,
         exists (select 1 from "marts"."sales"."target_vs_actual_daily" t
                 where t.hierarchy_level = 'material_group' and t.business_date between p.period_start and p.period_end) as targets_available
  from period p
),
pairs as (
  select s.store_code, s.store_name, h.material_group_code as subcategory_code
  from (select store_code, any_value(store_name) as store_name from "gold"."masters"."store" group by 1) s
  cross join (select distinct material_group_code from "gold"."masters"."merchandise_hierarchy" where material_group_code is not null) h
)
select pr.store_code, pr.store_name, pr.subcategory_code, c.period_start, c.effective_end as data_through, c.targets_available
from pairs pr cross join cutoff c

tables.name: feather_dash.store_rollout
tables.label: Store rollout
tables.description: Stores whose people are scoped by the new store org chart, and since when. Only a System Manager writes it.

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The store's plant code, as the scope filters name it.

tables.name: feather_dash.store_floor
tables.label: Store floor
tables.description: The floors of a store. A section names its floor; a Floor Manager's job assignment names one.

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The store's plant code, as the scope filters name it.

columns.label: Floor key
columns.description: Set on save: the store and the floor name. Unique, so a store has each floor once.

tables.name: feather_dash.department
tables.label: Department
tables.description: A named group of sections in one store, which may span floors. A Department Manager's job assignment names one.

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The store's plant code, as the scope filters name it.

columns.label: Department key
columns.description: The department's identity in its store. Loads match on it, and it never changes.

columns.label: Name
columns.description: Optional until the store names the department; then unique in the store.

columns.label: Department
columns.description: Set on save: the name, or the key while the name is blank.

columns.label: Department store key
columns.description: Set on save: the store and the department key. Unique per store.

columns.label: Name store key
columns.description: Set on save: the store and the name, empty while the name is blank. Unique per store.

tables.name: feather_dash.section
tables.label: Section
tables.description: One area of one store, named uniquely in that store. Its subcategories come from section_subcategory.

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The store's plant code, as the scope filters name it.

columns.label: Floor
columns.description: One of this store's floors. Optional for a store without floors.

columns.label: Department
columns.description: One of this store's departments. Plain and undated.

columns.label: Team Leaders allowed
columns.description: How many non-acting Team Leaders this section may have. More are listed as a conflict.

columns.label: Section key
columns.description: Set on save: the store and the section name. Unique, so a store has each section name once.

tables.name: feather_dash.section_subcategory
tables.label: Section subcategory
tables.description: Which section owns a subcategory in a store, from starts_on up to but not including ends_on. All its credit and coverage go to that section.

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The store's plant code, as the scope filters name it.

columns.label: Subcategory
columns.description: SAP's nine-digit subcategory code (`material_group_code`).

columns.label: Ends on
columns.description: Exclusive: the first day it no longer holds. Empty means current.

columns.label: Placement key
columns.description: Set on save: the store, the subcategory and starts_on. Unique.

tables.name: feather_dash.display_location
tables.label: Display location
tables.description: An extra place a subcategory is shown, for floor audits. It never moves credit or coverage.

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The store's plant code, as the scope filters name it.

columns.label: Subcategory
columns.description: SAP's nine-digit subcategory code (`material_group_code`).

columns.label: Ends on
columns.description: Exclusive: the first day it no longer holds. Empty means current.

tables.name: feather_dash.job_assignment
tables.label: Job assignment
tables.description: Who holds which job, where and when. A person's coverage is worked out from their current rows, acting included.

columns.label: Job
columns.choices:
Store Manager
Floor Manager
Department Manager
Team Leader
Staff
Cluster Manager

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The store's plant code, as the scope filters name it.

columns.label: Floor
columns.description: Floor Manager only.

columns.label: Department
columns.description: Department Manager only: one row per department.

columns.label: Section
columns.description: Team Leader and Staff only.

columns.label: Acting
columns.description: Acting cover; the absent person's row stays open.

columns.label: Ends on
columns.description: Exclusive: the first day it no longer holds. Empty means current.

tables.name: feather_dash.section_alias
tables.label: Section alias
tables.description: Another system's name for a section.

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The store's plant code, as the scope filters name it.

columns.label: Alias key
columns.description: Set on save: the store, the source and the alias. Unique.

tables.name: feather_dash.floor_alias
tables.label: Floor alias
tables.description: Another system's name for a floor.

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The store's plant code, as the scope filters name it.

columns.label: Alias key
columns.description: Set on save: the store, the source and the alias. Unique.

tables.name: feather_dash.job_alias
tables.label: Job alias
tables.description: Another system's name for a job, matched as a whole value. Central: the same in every store.

columns.label: Job
columns.choices:
Store Manager
Floor Manager
Department Manager
Team Leader
Staff
Cluster Manager

columns.label: Alias key
columns.description: Set on save: the source and the alias. Unique.
